assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Project: Khaled Suleiman middle school (grades7-9) Arabic games hub. Premium luminous glass 3D editorial still-life, rounded translucent frosted glass and polished acrylic, believable depth/refraction/beveled edges, soft ambient occlusion. Palette only ice-white #F5F8FC, cobalt #2563EB, cyan #06B6D4, violet #7C3AED, small warm orange #EA580C accents. Airy pale background, elegant modern educational aesthetic for teenagers, not infantile, not dark/neon/gaming. Landscape 4:3, central composition with 10% safe margins. No lettering, text, numerals, logo, watermark, human figures or faces. Not flat icons; tactile three-dimensional rendered sculptures. Subject: A central translucent violet/cyan orbital playground on an oval frosted-glass plinth: a luminous clear puzzle cube, a small cobalt robot with simple abstract sensor (no face), an open frosted book, an orange-and-white sports ball, a leaf and small orbit ring, balanced sophisticated composition like an exhibition of discoveries. Large central composition for a website hero. All objects fully visible.
